title: Ranking Employees with RANK()
description: Rank employees within each department by salary using the RANK() window function.

data.text: Write a query to rank employees within each department by salary, showing tied salaries with the same rank.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT
    EmployeeID,
    FirstName,
    LastName,
    Department,
    Salary,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Department ORDER BY Salary DESC) AS SalaryRank
FROM Employees
ORDER BY Department, SalaryRank;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: RANK() assigns ranks with gaps for ties (1, 2, 2, 4). DENSE_RANK() assigns consecutive ranks (1, 2, 2, 3). ROW_NUMBER() always gives a unique sequential number (1, 2, 3, 4) even for ties. Choose based on whether you want ties to share a rank.
